d:
Chief Justice of India Surya Kant expressed strong displeasure over judicial officers repeatedly seeking service-related and retirement benefits.
He questioned their courtroom attendance, work ethic and case disposal, alleging that some officers were unavailable in court during working hours.
The CJI remarked that judicial officers appeared more concerned about perks, allowances and retirement benefits than pending cases.
The comments came during a hearing concerning district judge recruitment in Kerala and eligibility under the direct recruitment quota.
